topic: What Happens After You Submit an Application?
objective: Explain the post-submission stage to reduce anxiety during waiting periods.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Once submitted, an application moves through verification, credit assessment and often a request for clarifying information. It can feel quiet from the outside, but there's usually active assessment happening, and a broker can chase updates on your behalf.

caption:
The period after submitting an application can feel like a black box, but there's genuine work happening — verification, credit checks, and serviceability assessment all take time, even when nothing visible seems to be occurring.

A broker's role at this stage includes following up on your behalf, so you're not left guessing.
